title: From Hidden Gas Chambers to Israel’s Viewing Gallows
author: Jamal Kanj
content:
What’s the difference between the Auschwitz-Birkenau complex and the Israeli
Zionist gallows? Auschwitz-Birkenau did not come with a special “[viewing
chamber](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/CqDqIjEjLxQ).”

That is not a metaphor. It is what Israeli National Security Minister Itamar
Ben Gvir announced on camera on August 19. He waved his hand and heralded to
his Instagram followers the gallows Israel plans to use to execute Palestinian
prisoners. Like a serial killer, a diabolical smirk on his face, he gloated as
he described his 21st-century [_damnatio ad
bestias_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Damnatio_ad_bestias).

Israeli culture didn't need a climate-controlled stage to derive pleasure from
watching Palestinian pain. For years, they did it at “[Sderot
Cinema](https://www.nytimes.com/2014/07/15/world/middleeast/israelis-watch-
bombs-drop-on-gaza-from-front-row-seats.html).” Residents of Jewish-only
colonies along the Gaza boundary have hauled lawn chairs and snacks and
huddled on the hilltops to watch the bombing of Gaza the way Americans watch
Fourth of July fireworks. They watched the bombs with awe and excitement,
cheering the massive explosions that lit up Gaza’s night sky and applauding
each plume of smoke rising from smoldering neighborhoods with unadulterated
cruelty.

This was not only since October 7, 2023, but back to 2014 where murder and
destruction was videoed and normalized as a form of public entertainment. The
[open-air cinema](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vUkfBYq7YhE\\) that once
required a folding chair on a hill now gets an enclosed theater, offering the
Israeli audience more comfortable seating to maximize its pleasure. Designed
by a minister who
[celebrated](https://edition.cnn.com/2026/05/04/world/video/israeli-minister-
celebrates-birthday-noose-digvid-vrtc) his 50th birthday with a noose-
decorated cake and a message, “Congratulations minister Ben Gvir, sometimes
dreams come true.”

This is Zionist [Schadenfreude](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schadenfreude):
a culture that needs a viewing chamber for an execution because it has been
indoctrinated, for years, to see Palestinian death as entertainment. From
hilltop watch parties to [sea
cruises](https://www.instagram.com/reels/DVHRfA0AfdR/) and the gallows room,
it is the same impulse, some enacted in the open air, the other behind closed
doors.

The execution law passed by the Knesset last March, making death the mandatory
sentence for freedom fighters resisting illegal colonizers. The same law does
not apply to the Jewish mobs who have murdered
[twelve](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/07/1168045) Palestinian civilians
since the beginning of this year alone, and
[nine](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/aug/03/palestinian-village-
trapped-surge-settler-violence-turmus-ayya-west-bank) American citizens since
2022. Rarely, if ever, do Jewish killers get indicted for their crimes against
Palestinians or Palestinian Americans.

The Association for Civil Rights in Israel petitioned the Supreme Court
arguing the Knesset had _no_ authority to legislate for people who are not its
citizens. The foreign ministers of Germany, France, Italy and the UK warned of
the bill's “de facto discriminatory character.” Eight Muslim-majority
governments called it part of a system that “entrench[es] apartheid.”

The gallows are not being built in isolation. Israel holds roughly 9,200
Palestinians in custody, almost
[40%](https://www.btselem.org/administrative_detention/statistics), including
[191 minors](https://www.timesofisrael.com/number-of-palestinian-minors-in-
israeli-administrative-detention-rises-sharply-data/), are [administrative
detainees](https://addameer.ps/israeli_military_judicial_system/administrative_detention),
held without charge, and without trial. Doctors
[kidnapped](https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2025/feb/25/more-
than-160-gazan-medics-held-in-israeli-prisons-amid-reports-of-torture) from
the hospital’s operation rooms, students and
[educators](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/26/political-arrest-
palestinian-academic-nadera-shalhoub-kevorkian-israel-civil-liberties-threat)
from their universities or elected legislatures from their homes. A six-month
extendable military detention, a Palestinian can vanish into the Israeli
prison system indefinitely. Civilian hostages held by Israel as bargaining
chips for exchanges. A law that applies exclusively to non-Jews in the West
Bank and Gaza. While [Jewish mobs](https://palestine.un.org/en/320945-settler-
encroachments-and-attacks-palestinian-homes-are-beyond-boiling-point)
terrorizing West Bank villages are immured from the same military law.

Since October 2023 at least
[98](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/nov/17/at-least-98-palestinians-
have-died-in-custody-since-october-2023-israeli-data-shows) Palestinian
hostages, a little over one percent of all held in the Israeli dungeons have
died or killed, most showing signs of
[torture](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-10-21/ty-article-
magazine/.premium/beatings-burns-attempted-sexual-assault-settlers-and-
soldiers-abused-
palestinians/0000018b-530f-d1d7-ab8b-7f5fca1d0000?lts=1700498268582); freed
detainees describe electric shocks, dog attacks, and sexual assault during
interrogation. UN expert [called](https://www.un.org/unispal/document/un-
expert-warns-torture-has-become-state-doctrine-in-israel-making-prisons-
instruments-of-genocide-and-torture/) Israeli torture as state doctrine. In
fact, the torture at [Abu Ghraib
prison](https://www.democracynow.org/2016/4/7/ex_abu_ghraib_interrogator_israelis_trained)
in Iraq was a carbon copy of Israeli torture chambers. A system that imprisons
without charging them or uses extrajudicial executions to murder activists
does not need much retooling to start hanging them.

Four UN special rapporteurs, including the expert on extrajudicial executions,
[declared](https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2026/04/israels-death-
penalty-law-constitutes-discriminatory-regime-capital) in April that the
execution law “constitutes a discriminatory regime” and manifestly violates
Israel's obligations under international law. The International Court of
Justice's 2024 finding that Israel's policies in the occupied Palestinian land
breach the prohibition on racial segregation and apartheid.
[Writing](https://opiniojuris.org/2026/05/18/is-israels-new-death-penalty-for-
terrorists-law-an-act-of-apartheid/) in Opinio Juris, a professor of criminal
law laid out the case that the new Israeli law may meet the Rome Statute's
definition of the crime against humanity of apartheid, by establishing an
institutionalized regime of domination by one racial group over another. He
noted the precedent is clear in apartheid South Africa where it instituted a
compulsory death penalty against the Black majority.

Put the pieces together and the picture is not ambiguous. A state culture with
a documented host parties of civilians gathering to cheer bombing of civilians
and now with a stage designed for spectators. A prison system that holds
thousands without charge, and is already responsible for dozens of documented
deaths in custody, now seeks to codify that impunity into law. A court system
that tries one person (non-Jew) under military law and the other under
civilian law (Jew) has produced a judicial apartheid.

Eighty years ago, the gas chambers were hidden because even their Nazi
designers understood, at some level, that the world would not tolerate
watching. Israel's national security minister is building a killing chamber
"with a view," boasted about on Instagram, next door to a hillside culture
that has spent decades in watch parties celebrating war crimes, rehearsing all
along for the next damnatio ad bestias, a 21st-century Zionist Schadenfreude.

The post [From Hidden Gas Chambers to Israel's Viewing
Gallows](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/08/27/from-hidden-gas-chambers-to-
israels-viewing-gallows/) appeared first on
[CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
